info.title: BhoomiScan Land Verification API
info.description:
Backend API for land-record verification: mobile OTP login, Razorpay subscriptions, Surepass land records
for 13 states (Punjab, Maharashtra, Bihar, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Delhi, Andaman & Nicobar, Goa, Chhattisgarh, Telangana, Sikkim, Tripura), snapshots with change detection, alerts and smart-contract anchoring.

**Auth.** Call `POST /api/auth/mobile-verify`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (set it once in the Apidog environment / Auth tab).

**Land flow per state.** `GET /{state}/districts` → each `POST /{state}/<list>` with the values chosen so far → `POST /{state}/verify`.
Each state folder contains its lists in order, with working example bodies. Land endpoints need an active subscription.

**Envelope.** Success: `{ "success": true, "data": ..., "meta"?: ... }`. Error: `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "details"? }, "requestId" }`.

State.name: state
State.description: State slug. Supported states come from `GET /land-verification/states`.

level.description: State-specific list name, e.g. districts, tehsils, talukas, survey-numbers.

post.summary: Verify the MSG91 widget OTP and get a login token
post.description:
The app runs the MSG91 widget's sendOtp() and gets a reqId. The backend verifies the OTP
with MSG91 (widget verifyOtp), finds or creates the user, and issues a JWT.
Same API as the reference backend's server/mobileVerify.js.

400.description: Invalid mobile number / Invalid OTP / reqId is required

401.description: Invalid or expired OTP, or mobile does not match the OTP session

502.description: Unable to verify OTP with MSG91

503.description: Mobile OTP login is not configured on the server

post.summary: Create a PENDING subscription (idempotent per plan while unpaid)
Create a Razorpay order for a PENDING subscription
post.description: Amount and currency come from the stored subscription, never from the client.

201.description: Order created; open Razorpay Checkout with `checkout`

post.summary: Verify Checkout result and activate the subscription
post.description:
Checks the Checkout signature, then fetches the payment from Razorpay and checks
order id, amount, currency and status (captures `authorized` payments) before activating.

Verified with `x-razorpay-signature` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the webhook secret),
idempotent on `x-razorpay-event-id`. Handles payment.captured, order.paid, payment.authorized,
payment.failed, refund.processed, payment.refunded.

get.summary: Supported states, their providers and their form fields
get.description:
Each state lists its `fields` in drill-down order. A field has `name`, `label`,
`input` (`select` or `text`), `dependsOn` (fields that must be filled first) and,
for selects, `options` = { method, path, body } describing the list endpoint and
which field values to send. Clients build the form from this instead of hardcoding it.

get.summary: Land verification with latest snapshot and its changes
Snapshot history (newest first, without raw responses)
One snapshot including the raw provider response and its changes

put.description: Enabling requires an active subscription whose plan allows the frequency; disabling never does.
